details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, and K5 are fully present with supporting sentences covering all core elements. K4 is partially present as it mentions vehicle finance and consumer finance segments and highlights growth in East Africa and digital offerings, but omits specific portfolio splits (e.g., 67% vehicle finance) and details about exits from Balkan/Belarus. K6 is partially present as it references electric motorcycle financing and digital/sustainable mobility offerings, but lacks explicit mention of geographic expansion and the full ESG strategy timeline. K7 is missing entirely as there is no mention of post-reporting period events such as the March 2025 bond tap or expected tax refund.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support the overall narrative of record financial performance in 2024. There are no self-contradictions: revenue, loan issuance, EBITDA, and profit figures consistently show year-over-year growth. Explanations (e.g., excluding one-off VAT liability in S8-S9) are clear and logically connected. The organization flows logically from revenue and portfolio growth to profitability metrics, strategic milestones, and risk factors. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity. All relationships between figures (e.g., revenue growth, portfolio expansion, profit increases) are consistent and support the summary's central claim of record performance.
